course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review register, nuance, and clear correction in one integrated interaction.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A practical message must be discussed, corrected, softened, and reformulated for the right recipient.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Choosing tone, correcting details, and summarizing a final response.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik review a draft message about a booking or housing issue, correct one wrong detail, soften the tone, and decide on a final version.

main_focus.name: integrated register and nuance control
main_focus.description: Combine polite request language, hedging, contrastive correction, and source framing in a short practical review.
model_examples: Det gäller inte bokningen i morgon utan tiden nästa vecka.
Jag skulle nog skriva det lite mer neutralt.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 1-2 polite request frames, 1-2 nuance markers, and 1 contrastive correction if natural.

vocabulary_target.theme: register and nuance review in a practical message
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use review vocabulary to discuss wording choices in a compact, realistic exchange.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker shows a draft or possible wording that feels not quite right.
dialogue_shape.middle: They correct one detail, soften one sentence, and discuss whether the tone fits the recipient.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on the final wording and summarize why it works better.

target_complexity.repetition: spiral Week 3 register and nuance tools without adding new forms

focus: the wording or detail that needs adjustment
the reason the tone is changed

sentence_focus: one sentence softening a direct message
one sentence with inte... utan correcting a detail
one sentence with nog expressing nuance
one sentence summarizing why the final tone works
